nodes.name: Integrations
nodes.purpose: Connect the agency platform to external systems — Case Portfolio for worker proof-of-work, payment rails, SMS/email providers, and future third-party connections.
nodes.ux_intent: Integrations are invisible to end users — they just experience richer profiles, faster payments, and instant notifications without knowing what's powering it.
nodes.vertical_notes: Case Portfolio is the primary integration — it turns a worker's assignment history into a shareable proof-of-work profile that clients can trust. Payment rails must support mobile money (M-Pesa) and card.
nodes.case_integration: This category IS the Case Portfolio integration.
open_questions: Which SMS provider: Africa's Talking vs Twilio vs Supabase built-in?

nodes.name: Case Portfolio Integration
nodes.purpose: Sync completed assignment data, credentials, and ratings from the agency platform into the worker's Case Portfolio profile — building a rich, verifiable proof-of-work profile automatically.
nodes.ux_intent: Workers never have to manually update their Case profile — it grows every time they complete a job. Seeing their profile strengthen is motivating.
outputs: Case API calls: proof items, vouches, credentials
nodes.vertical_notes: Nanny: completed assignment → Case 'did' proof item ('Provided daily nanny care for 2 children aged 3 and 5, 6 months, Nairobi'). Credential verified → Case 'trained' proof item ('DBS Enhanced Check — verified'). Client rating → Case 'vouched' proof item.
open_questions: Should workers be able to control which assignments appear on their Case profile?

nodes.name: Push 'Did' Proof Item to Case
nodes.purpose: After an assignment is completed, create a 'did' proof item on the worker's Case Portfolio representing the work experience.
nodes.ux_intent: The worker's Case profile auto-gains an entry: 'Provided wrap-around nanny care for infant and toddler, Westlands — Oct 2024'. No manual entry.
inputs: assignment{id, service_type, care_type, child_ages|null, duration, org_name, location_area}
nodes.vertical_notes: Caregiving 'did' item: includes care type (infant/elderly), agency name (omitted if client privacy requires), duration. Cleaning 'did' item: service type (deep clean, end-of-tenancy), property type, number of bedrooms.
open_questions: What level of detail is acceptable without compromising client privacy?

nodes.name: Push 'Trained' Proof Item to Case
nodes.purpose: When a credential is verified by an admin, push a 'trained' proof item to the worker's Case profile representing the qualification.
nodes.ux_intent: The DBS badge appears on the worker's Case profile the moment the admin approves it — instant credibility boost.
nodes.vertical_notes: Credential types: 'Enhanced DBS Check', 'Paediatric First Aid (OFQUAL)', 'NVQ Level 3 Childcare', 'COSHH Certificate'. Expiry date displayed so viewers know it's current.

nodes.name: Push 'Vouched' Proof Item to Case
nodes.purpose: After a client submits a positive rating with a review comment, push it as a 'vouched' proof item to the worker's Case profile.
nodes.ux_intent: A 5-star review from a parent automatically becomes a vouch on the worker's Case profile — building their reputation across both platforms.
nodes.vertical_notes: Only push ratings of 4★ or above. The review comment becomes the vouch quote. Reviewer is listed as 'A family in [location]' to preserve client privacy.
open_questions: Should workers be able to suppress specific ratings from appearing as Case vouches?

nodes.name: Link Worker to Case Account
nodes.purpose: Connect a worker's agency platform identity to their existing Case Portfolio handle — enabling bidirectional data sync.
nodes.ux_intent: During worker onboarding: 'Do you have a Case profile? Link it here to auto-populate your experience.' A single input field.
nodes.vertical_notes: Some nannies will already have a Case profile they've been building independently. Linking it gives the agency access to their existing proof items.
open_questions: If a worker doesn't have a Case account, should we auto-create one?

nodes.name: Payment Rails
nodes.purpose: Integrate with external payment providers to enable clients to pay invoices and workers to receive payouts, supporting both card and mobile money.
nodes.ux_intent: Paying feels instant and familiar — the same payment flow a user knows from their favourite app, with no friction or redirects.
nodes.vertical_notes: M-Pesa is the primary collection method in Kenya (Paystack integration). Card for international clients. UK market: Stripe with bank transfer support.
open_questions: Which market to launch in first? Kenya (Paystack/M-Pesa) or UK (Stripe/bank transfer)?

nodes.name: Initiate Client Payment
nodes.purpose: Create a payment intent with the payment provider, returning a client-facing checkout URL or session for an invoice.
nodes.ux_intent: The 'Pay Now' button goes directly to a familiar checkout — Paystack or Stripe hosted page. No extra steps.
nodes.vertical_notes: Anon clients receive a payment link via SMS/email — clicking it opens the checkout directly. No login required.

nodes.name: Handle Payment Webhook
nodes.purpose: Verify the HMAC signature of incoming payment webhook events and route them to update invoice and payout state.
nodes.ux_intent: Invisible to users — payment confirmation just appears instantly on both client and admin dashboards.
nodes.vertical_notes: Security: NEVER trust client-side payment confirmation. Always wait for the verified webhook before marking paid.

nodes.name: Disburse Worker Payout
nodes.purpose: Initiate a bank transfer or mobile money payout to a worker's verified settlement account via the payment provider's transfer API.
nodes.ux_intent: Workers see 'Transfer initiated' and receive their money within 1 business day — no chasing needed.
nodes.vertical_notes: Kenya: Paystack Transfers API (M-Pesa). UK: Stripe Payouts (bank transfer).

nodes.name: Email Provider
nodes.purpose: Integrate with a transactional email service to deliver platform notifications, invoices, and booking confirmations.
nodes.ux_intent: Emails arrive instantly and render beautifully on mobile — agency-branded, professional, never in spam.

nodes.name: Send Transactional Email
nodes.purpose: Deliver a single transactional email via the configured provider's API.
nodes.ux_intent: Email lands in inbox within seconds — not minutes.

nodes.name: SMS Provider
nodes.purpose: Integrate with an SMS gateway to send booking confirmations, OTPs, reminders, and payment links to clients and workers via text message.
nodes.ux_intent: SMS arrives in under 10 seconds — concise, clear, with a short link when action is needed.
nodes.vertical_notes: Africa's Talking is preferred for Kenya (local deliverability + M-Pesa integration). Twilio for UK/international.
open_questions: Africa's Talking vs Twilio vs Supabase built-in for OTP?

nodes.name: Send SMS
nodes.purpose: Deliver a single SMS to a phone number via the configured gateway API.
nodes.ux_intent: The SMS feels personal — concise, first-name addressed, with a direct link if action is needed.

nodes.name: File Storage (R2 / Cloud)
nodes.purpose: Store and serve credential documents (DBS scans, certificates), worker photos, evidence files, and any other uploaded documents via Cloudflare R2 or equivalent.
nodes.ux_intent: Uploading a certificate feels instant — progress bar, then a green tick. Files are private and securely accessible only to the right people.
nodes.vertical_notes: Credential documents are sensitive — DBS certificates are private (admin + worker only). Worker profile photos are public. Evidence for Case Portfolio is public.
nodes.case_integration: Uses same R2 bucket pattern as Case Portfolio for media storage.

nodes.name: Generate Signed Upload URL
nodes.purpose: Return a short-lived signed PUT URL so the client can upload directly to R2 without routing the binary through the app server.
nodes.ux_intent: Upload is fast because it goes straight to the CDN — users don't wait for the server to proxy the file.
nodes.vertical_notes: Credential docs require identity verification before a signed URL is issued. Never issue a public URL for private credential documents.
nodes.case_integration: Identical pattern to Case Portfolio's /api/upload/sign route.

nodes.name: Get Secure Download URL
nodes.purpose: Generate a short-lived signed GET URL for a private file (like a DBS certificate) accessible only to authorised users.
nodes.ux_intent: Clicking 'View certificate' instantly opens the document in a secure viewer — no download nag, no re-authentication.
nodes.vertical_notes: Only workers can view their own credential docs. Only admins can view all workers' credential docs.

nodes.name: Analytics & Observability
nodes.purpose: Track platform-level events (page views, booking funnel steps, conversion rates) for admin insights and product improvement.
nodes.ux_intent: Admins see a clear dashboard: 'X visitors this week, Y booking enquiries, Z conversions'. No data science required.
nodes.case_integration: Shares the same analytics pattern as Case Portfolio's analytics_events log.

nodes.name: Log Analytics Event
nodes.purpose: Append a lightweight, anonymised event to the platform's analytics log — used for funnel analysis and admin dashboard.
nodes.ux_intent: Users never feel watched — analytics are aggregated and never personally identifiable on the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: View Booking Funnel
nodes.purpose: Show admin where visitors drop off in the booking flow — helping identify friction points and improve conversion.
nodes.ux_intent: A simple funnel chart: 'Visited → Clicked Book → Completed → Converted'. Actionable at a glance.
